_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the canonical-primitives session-context payload. The SessionStart hook (tools/hooks/session-start-context-inject.sh) renders THIS json directly; there is no hand-maintained markdown mirror (retired 2026-05-31 per founder directive). Each section cites its authority ADR(s) so drift is detectable. Detailed/verbose doctrine lives in the per-topic specs/ADRs referenced under `pointers`, not here.

sections.title: VCS / Git
lines: Canonical: plain `git`; retired CLI wrapper/ratchet aliases must not be used.
Substrate of record: self-hosted Forgejo (forgejo.oya-forge.svc). GitHub is a working mirror, not of-record.
Governance readiness is reported by CI/controller status plus reviewer approval; hook output intentionally avoids CLI command guidance while the CLI retirement lands.

sections.title: CI gate (the merge gate)
lines: Canonical: the bespoke-Rust `oya-ci-controller` (Prow-style: plank spawns gate Jobs, crier posts the `oya-ci-gate` Forgejo commit status). Triggered by ci-webhook-gateway (HMAC-verified Forgejo webhook).

RETIRED for the gate: the Jenkins gate pipeline (Jenkinsfile-oya-ci-gate) and the interim Argo-Workflows orchestration. Jenkins LTS remains ONLY the ephemeral CI build/test FARM (agents), not the gate.
Merge-queue: tide (ADR-0513, folds ADR-0111 projected-merge-state).
TRANSITIONAL: dev branch-protection does not yet REQUIRE `oya-ci-gate`; a temporary relax-merge is in effect until CI-go-live (gated on local green).

sections.title: Coordination (per agent lane)
lines: one isolated worktree branch per agent lane (one lane = one worktree)
commit + push on that lane; open a PR against `dev` (enters the governance pipeline)
merge readiness = `oya-ci-gate` (controller-posted) green + reviewer-agent APPROVE; admitted via the tide merge-queue

sections.title: Repo layout / tenancy
lines: Top-level: `cloud/` = the platform being sold; `oya/` = the product, which runs as a TENANT of that platform. (`microservices/` top-level layout is LEGACY — migrated.)
Pattern: vertical-slice nesting, ONE root Cargo workspace, crate = bounded-context, clean-arch-as-modules, Buck2 build graph.
Dogfood purity (gate-enforced target): ZERO `oya/` -> `cloud/` INTERNAL code deps; oya consumes cloud only via the public/tenant surface.
Vocabulary: cloud = "tenant/tenancy"; oya = "organization/org".

sections.title: Contracts
lines: OpenAPI 3.2.0 (NOT 3.3 / 3.1.0 / 3.0.0) — https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.2.0
AsyncAPI 3.1.0 (NOT 3.0.0 / 2.x) — https://www.asyncapi.com/docs/reference/specification/v3.1.0
Schema language: proto3 (NOT proto2)
HTTP stack: hyper PREFERRED low-level; axum SANCTIONED-with-justification; enforced by the HTTP stack policy gate (specs/http-stack-policy.json).

sections.title: In-memory KV / cache / pubsub
lines: Canonical: Valkey 8.x (LF BSD-3-Clause fork of Redis 7.2.4). Wire protocol RESP3.
RETIRED: Redis 7.4+ (SSPLv1/RSALv2). FORBIDDEN: DragonflyDB (BSL-1.1).
Counterpart-fact preservation: external-product Redis references remain quote-bound; do NOT migrate counterpart facts.

sections.title: K8s admission
lines: Canonical DEFAULT: in-tree ValidatingAdmissionPolicy + CEL (+ MutatingAdmissionPolicy) — GA on the 1.36.1 cluster.
Signing residue: a bespoke-Rust cosign-verify webhook (shares the OCI-registry + signer product).
DEMOTED: Kubewarden (CNCF Sandbox / single-vendor). Kyverno removed from the base overlay. Cedar = app-layer authz, NOT admission.

sections.title: Containers / OCI images
lines: Runtime: containerd. Docker (Docker Inc. tooling) is FORBIDDEN.
Images: bespoke buck2-native OCI (crane-free; tools/oci/push-oci-image.py + oya-oci-assemble), distroless/static base, fully-static aarch64-musl binaries.
Layer compression (per-use): upstream base layers gzip; frequently-pulled app layers tar+zstd.

sections.title: Build toolchain
lines: Build system: Buck2. Active scripts, CI, CD, and build/test lanes MUST use Buck2, not Cargo.
Cargo executable exception: production release image/binary optimization evidence only, with release profile, target triple, binary-size/codegen/allocator data, commit SHA, and non-claim label.
Cargo metadata/vendor exception: Buck2/Reindeer graph generation only; never build/test/merge authority.
Linkers: wild (linux) + Apple ld-prime (mac); mold SUPERSEDED; lld is the standing fallback. Never zig-lld.
Hermetic, pinned toolchains as Buck2 build inputs (single-bootstrap / dev==CI / zero drift).

sections.title: Secrets
lines: Canonical: OpenBao (MPL-2; supersedes Vault BUSL), synced into k8s via External Secrets Operator (ClusterSecretStore `openbao-cluster-store`).
`.env` (OpenBao + Forgejo admin tokens) is NEVER committed or echoed.

sections.title: Forbidden primitives (summary)
lines: No retired VCS wrapper aliases (use plain git). No Docker. OpenAPI must be 3.2.0; AsyncAPI must be 3.1.0.
The term "foundry" is ERADICATED corpus-wide — do NOT introduce it as a canonical primitive (historical references only).
Full list: specs/forbidden-operations.json + specs/master-plan-sequencing.json#forbidden_primitives.

sections.title: Common pitfalls
lines: Using retired VCS wrapper aliases instead of plain git + PR + the bespoke oya-ci gate.
Citing Jenkins/Kyverno as the canonical gate/admission (both superseded — bespoke controller + in-tree VAP/CEL).
Writing `openapi: 3.3.0` or `asyncapi: 3.0.0`.
Treating `microservices/` as the live top-level layout (it is `cloud/` + `oya/`).
Vacuous-green gates (test passes on empty input).
ADR references in docs without a corresponding docs/decisions/ADR-NNNN-*.md.

pointers._note: Verbose per-topic doctrine is NOT duplicated here; read these directly when relevant.
